idle.notes: Stable breathing, minimal head motion; no visible joint separation at256/192.

walk.notes: Alternating support and swing, calf/ankle coupling, controlled bow. World-material contact tested independently.

attack_01.notes: Retrieve gesture, nock, face-level aim, one release, follow-through; continuous string and no visible limb disconnection. Compact near-shoulder fold retained as nonblocking.

hit.notes: Brief readable recoil; no equipment drift or joint break.

death.notes: One leg gives way while the other flat sole supports, then kneeling, forward fall and grounded head/forearms. Final pose holds; bow released by keyed socket.

flags: NON_BLOCKING_COMBAT_ARTIFACT: approved high-resolution alpha/edge sampling artifacts remain unchanged.

Death finishes in a somewhat more extended pose than the reference strip; phase logic and grounded endpoint are retained.
